name: Born Global Companies
description: Describe the concept of born global companies and their approaches to international expansion
author: IELTS Practice Team

questions.text:
Describe the concept of 'born global' companies.

You should say:

  • what 'born global' companies are
  • how these companies use technology and partnerships
  • what the advantages and limitations of using diaspora networks are
  • and explain what other strategies entrepreneurs can use to expand internationally.

Speak about the topic for 2 minutes. Take one minute to think about what you are going to say, adding any examples from the lecture or your own experience.
